title: Piping & Instrumentation Diagram Register - YD-2301
content:
PIPING & INSTRUMENTATION DIAGRAM (P&ID) REGISTER: YD-2301 (POLYMER FLUID BED DRYER).
Document No: TJC-LLD-PID-2301, Title: Powder Drying System – YD-2301.
Area: 2300 – POWDER DRYING SYSTEM, Functional Location: TJC-LLD-2300-01.
INSTRUMENT & PROCESS CONTROL LOOPS:
- TSHH-2301: Outlet temperature HIGH-HIGH (Temperature Switch) [Setpoint: > 125 degC]. Function: Trip initiator T1 → SEQ-5500. Location: Powder outlet line. Interlock: SEQ-5500 T1
- FSLL-2302: Nitrogen purge flow LOW-LOW (Flow Switch) [Setpoint: < 200 kg/h]. Function: Trip initiator T2 → SEQ-5500. Location: N2 purge line. Interlock: SEQ-5500 T2
- LSHH-2303: Inlet chute level HIGH-HIGH (Level Switch) [Setpoint: > 90 %]. Function: Trip initiator T3 → SEQ-5500. Location: Powder inlet chute. Interlock: SEQ-5500 T3
- SSLL-2305: Drum speed LOW-LOW (chain slip) (Speed Switch) [Setpoint: < 1 rpm]. Function: Trip initiator T4 → SEQ-5500. Location: Drum drive / sprocket. Interlock: SEQ-5500 T4
- ASHH-2307: Vent O2 HIGH-HIGH (Analyzer Switch) [Setpoint: > 8 % O2]. Function: Trip initiator T5 → SEQ-5500. Location: Vent line. Interlock: SEQ-5500 T5
- MPR-2301: Drive motor overload (Protection Relay) [Setpoint: MPR relay —]. Function: Trip initiator T6 (overload/electrical fault). Location: Motor MCC. Interlock: SEQ-5500 T6
- TV-2301: Steam Inlet Valve (Control Valve) [Setpoint: CLOSED —]. Function: EFF-2: Close on trip; stop heat. Location: Steam inlet line. Interlock: SEQ-5500 EFF-2
- FV-2302: N2 Purge Valve (Control Valve) [Setpoint: OPEN —]. Function: EFF-4: Open on trip; max inert. Location: N2 purge line. Interlock: SEQ-5500 EFF-4
- XV-2210: Centrifuge Feed Isolation Valve (On/Off Valve) [Setpoint: CLOSED —]. Function: EFF-3: Trip centrifuge feed to stop powder. Location: Powder inlet line. Interlock: SEQ-5500 EFF-3
- GF-2210: Centrifuge Feed Unit (Pump / Motor) [Setpoint: STOP —]. Function: EFF-3: Trip centrifuge feed. Location: Centrifuge. Interlock: SEQ-5500 EFF-3
- AT-2307: Vent O2 Analyzer (Analyzer Transmitter) [Setpoint: < 5 % O2]. Function: Start permissive P1 (Inerting established). Location: Vent line. Interlock: SEQ-5500 P1
- ZSO-2304: Steam Condensate Drain Position (Open) (Limit Switch) [Setpoint: OPEN —]. Function: Start permissive P2. Location: Condensate drain. Interlock: SEQ-5500 P2
- PSL-2306: Gearbox Lube Oil Pressure LOW (Pressure Switch) [Setpoint: OK —]. Function: Start permissive P3 (Lube oil OK). Location: Gearbox lube oil. Interlock: SEQ-5500 P3
- TIC-2301: Temperature Controller (Temp Controller). Function: Control steam ramp-up via TV-2301. Location: DCS. Interlock: —
- FT-2302: Nitrogen Purge Flow Transmitter (Flow Transmitter). Function: Flow measurement for N2. Location: N2 purge line. Interlock: —
- PT-2304: Steam Pressure Transmitter (Pressure Transmitter). Function: Steam pressure monitoring. Location: Steam inlet line. Interlock: —
- MT-2306: Outlet Moisture Transmitter (Moisture Analyzer) [Setpoint: 300 ppm]. Function: Monitor outlet moisture. Location: Powder outlet line. Interlock: —
- HS-2301: Emergency Stop Hand Switch (Hand Switch) [Setpoint: Manual —]. Function: Local/DCS emergency stop. Location: Local control station. Interlock: —
CROSS REFERENCES: Datasheet: TJC-LLD-DS-YD-2301, Interlock: SEQ-5500.
